name: Jordan
label: Apple Music switcher who keeps returning
who: I've been on Spotify for about a decade, mostly on a family or student plan, and I mostly listen on my iPhone over Bluetooth. I've tried Apple Music several times and sometimes stay on it, but I keep returning to Spotify for playlists, sharing with friends and finding new artists.
value_for_money: Says Apple Music is cheaper with better audio quality ([12]) and that Spotify is more expensive than Apple Music ([35]); mentions a student price of about $7 a month on Spotify ([5]) and a $6 price on Apple Music after a trial ([27]); also says Spotify is cost effective for their use ([4]).
loyalty: Stays for years of playlists, shared family and friend playlists, and because Spotify still feels better for finding new music ([8],[9]); would move to Apple Music when it feels more consistent ([7],[27]).
pain_points: Recommendations keep repeating the same songs ([6])
Organization is hard to get used to and feels bloated ([7],[30])
reasons_to_stay: They value Spotify's discovery and the years of playlists, including shared family and friend playlists, that they would have to rebuild ([8],[9]). Several say Apple Music sounds better or is cheaper, but they keep returning because switching is a pain and Spotify still feels better for new music ([5],[8]).
tone: Casual and opinionated, often reporting back after trying a switch and weighing it against Spotify.
